description: Export a Cloud DB for PostgreSQL server log file to Object Storage. Use ncloud_list_postgresql_logs to get available log files.

bucketName.description: Object Storage bucket name to export to

fileName.description: Log file name to export (from ncloud_list_postgresql_logs)

folderPath.description: Folder path within the bucket (e.g. 'postgresql-logs/error'). If omitted, exports to bucket root.

logType.description: Log type to export (e.g. ERROR, SLOW, etc.)

name: ncloud_export_postgresql_log
